title: Inflation Explained with Chocolate
description:
Chocolate down. Money up. A three-second visual rush.

An illustrative material-area chart, not historical inflation data. The chocolate area represents getting less; the gold money area represents paying more. Inflation and shrinkflation simplified into one visual metaphor.

#Inflation #Shrinkflation #Shorts
firstComment: An illustrative visual metaphor, not historical price data.
